work.title: Untitled (Numan Collage)
work.description: Mixed-media collage dominated by a bold horizontal red band bearing white cut-leaf forms, above a dense lower zone of silver foil, compact discs, orange triangles, black geometric shapes, and scattered red fragments. Handwritten inscription 'NUMAN' appears at upper right; signed and dated 11/30/2022 at lower right.
work.composition: horizontal red band over fragmented lower zone
